messages:
cameron: CI push failing on PR #8431 after the Dockerfile change that adds a large tar in the image. Getting intermittent 403 during blob upload, looks like a chunk alignment problem. Logs: ```PUT /v2/redwood/runtime/blobs/uploads/xyz?digest=sha256:abc 403 \nserver: registry v2.1.9\nerror: upload invalid chunk range\n``` Can someone help triage?

maria: @cameron can you paste the exact docker build / push command the CI run used? and which runner (gke-builder-3)?

cameron: CI uses our buildkite job: `./ci/build-and-publish.sh --tag pr-8431` on `gke-builder-3`. The docker step uses `buildx --push`. I also repro locally once and saw `error parsing chunked body` from the registry.

jia: This smells like the kaniko/buildkit chunked upload bug we saw. Did the Dockerfile add any `COPY --from=` multi-stage that changes layer ordering?

cameron: yes added a new layer copying a 120MB .tar into `/opt/assets`. No change to compression flags.

mike: registry-bot shows a spike of 403s around build time for that project. registry-bot: `403 upload forbidden: chunk-offset-mismatch`

maria: Two quick checks: 1) try pushing with `--disable-content-trust`? (not likely) 2) rerun with `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0` to see if classic docker push behaves differently. Also can you try `skopeo copy docker-archive:img.tar docker://registry/repo:tag --dest-tls-verify=false` to see if it's client side.

cameron: will run both. also adding logs from the runner: ```buildkit: uploaded 3/5 chunks, server returned 403 on chunk 4, Content-Length: 0```

jia: If it's chunk alignment, sometimes gzip/content-length mismatches from how add/copy sets mtime can flip layer sizes. Try `tar --mtime='1970-01-01' -cf assets.tar ...` or build with `--build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1` to change layer packing for a test.

mike: I kicked a rerun of the CI job (build 7123) with buildkit disabled. If that passes, it's a BuildKit to registry interaction. If it fails, suspect registry proxy (s3 chunking) or auth token expiry.

ci-bot: Re-run started: buildkite.com/redwood/ci/7123 (triggered by mike) :repeat: 

cameron: local test: `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 ./ci/build-and-publish.sh` — push succeeded locally to a staging registry. So buildkit likely implicated.

maria: good repro. next step: bisect which buildkit version in our builders differs. @infra can we check the buildkit binary version on gke-builder-3 vs local?

mike: gke-builder-3 shows buildkit v0.11.4, local is v0.9.1. That could explain change in chunking behavior.

jia: filing quick bisect request: can someone try `BUILDKIT_FLAGS=--oci-mediatypes=false` or set `BUILDKITD_FLAGS=--rootless=false`? Also try `buildx bake --load` to avoid the push path and then push artifact with `skopeo` as a workaround.

cameron: tried `--oci-mediatypes=false` and it still 403s. I can push loaded tar with skopeo (works). For the immediate unblock I'll change CI to load + skopeo push for this PR and then do a follow-up to standardize.

maria: sounds good. please add a short note in PR describing the workaround and link this thread. Also open an infra ticket to upgrade/downgrade buildkit and test against our registry.

mike: created INFRA-1298: "investigate buildkit chunked upload mismatch v0.11.x" and linked logs.

registry-bot: Noted: a related incident on 2025-08-09 showing `chunk-offset-mismatch` for uploads from buildkit v0.11.x to s3-proxied registries.

cameron: thanks all — I'll push the workaround commit in a few mins and mark CI green. :thumbsup:

jia: follow-up: when you have a minute, please also capture the tarball's layer digests (`skopeo inspect`) and attach so infra can reproduce exactly.

cameron: will do, closing thread after PR merge.
